evidence.native: Installed 7.3.5 SpellEffect row 294419: spell 200011, effect index 0, effect 98 (knockback), targets 22/7 (caster source/area entry), trigger 204833 (stun). Original live DB has no implicit-target conditions for this spell.

The Summoning Portal is also a creature (101433), so an unrestricted unit-area selection can move it. The same Jagganoth entry is summoned by Calydus 99178 in the later map-1522 escape.
evidence.reference_scope: The Legion-era walkthrough documents Zelifrax's challenge, Jagganoth's response and capture, followed by the later escape. The exact new target whitelist is a repair inferred from native spell semantics and the existing scenario actors, not a claimed packet-sniff reconstruction.
evidence.reset: 10145600 id 3 calls 10145601 on self from its own timed list. SmartScript::SetScript9 explicitly rejects this while isProcessingTimedActionList is true. Action 200 in the recovery tail is BOSS_EVADE: it clears combat/threat and moves home; it does not replace or clear the timed list. There are no Ritssyn EVADE handlers that start another timed list.

repair: Source 13/effect mask 1 conditions restrict spell 200011 in maps 1220 and 1502 to quest-40729 players and council entries 101454/101455/101456/101457. Zelifrax, portal NPC/object, boss, jailers, pets and unrelated bystanders are excluded. Intended council/player knockback and its native strength/stun are retained.
An AND branch of two negative caster-map conditions preserves targeting outside Dalaran/Underbelly, including Calydus's later map-1522 scene.

Flatten 10145601's recovery actions into 10145600: hide at 136 seconds from list start, evade/home, restore NPC flags and visibility at 141 seconds. Keep the source recovery list and the engine's self-replacement guard unchanged. Match only the known broken call site and preserve customized calls.
